Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_FastTransfers: Fast Item Transfers With Fast Timed Actions
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_FastTransfers_to: In single player the Fast Timed Actions cheat makes moving items between containers quick. In multiplayer the server times every transfer itself and ignores the cheat, so an admin still waits the full time for each item. Tick this so the server moves items straight away for anyone who has Fast Timed Actions switched on and is allowed to use it. Transfers still play a short animation and still wait for the item to really arrive, so actions queued behind them, like eating out of a bag, keep working. Only works for staff with the cheat on; everyone else is not affected.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AnimalGenderChan: The gender button in the animal info window only flips a flag on the admin's own screen. The animal keeps its model, cannot mate as its new gender, and changes back for other players or after the chunk reloads. Tick this to change the animal's type along with its gender, so a sow really becomes a boar and the other way round, keeping its name, age, stats and genes, and to make the change on the server so everyone sees it and it is saved. Works for animals on the ground, in hutches, in trailers and carried in the inventory. Needs the Animal Cheats capability.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_ForagingDebugFix: In multiplayer the foraging debug menu's icons exist only on the admin's screen: added icons cannot be picked up, moving every icon in a zone does nothing and refreshing a zone does not clear anything. Picking up any forage icon also never actually hands over the items in multiplayer. Tick this to register added icons on the server so they can be picked up, move and refresh icons on the server too, and have the server grant the items when an icon is picked up.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_ItemEditorSync_t: The admin item editor only saves changes for items in a player's own inventory, and even then often not for other players' items, so an edited item in a crate, a vehicle or on the floor goes back to how it was. Tick this to send every changed field to the server, which applies it to its own copy of the item and tells everyone, wherever the item is. Needs the Edit Item capability.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_FixDebugAddFluid: Working Debug Add Fluid On World Objects

In multiplayer the debug Add Fluid option on a rain collector, barrel or other world object that holds fluid empties it instead of filling it, and nobody else sees the change. Tick this to fill the container to capacity with the chosen fluid on the server and send it to everyone. Feeding troughs and fluid containers on items already work and are not affected. Needs the Use Debug Context Menu capability.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminTagEveryChe: The admin panel says the red admin tag above a staff member's head shows while any cheat in its list is on, but the game forgets nine of them: fast move, unlimited ammo, know all recipes, brush tool, LootZed, loot log, animal cheats, animal extra values and always day. Tick this so the tag shows for every cheat in the panel. Hide Admin Tag While Cheating still hides it completely.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_HideAdminTag_too: Normally the red admin tag appears above a staff member's head whenever any admin panel cheat is switched on. Tick this to never show it. Switched off, the tag shows as Admin Tag For Every Cheat says.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_FixShinArmorRunS: Fix Metal Shin Armor Run Speed

Metal Shin Armor and Articulated Metal Shin Armor have their run speeds the wrong way round, so the jointed Blacksmith 8 upgrade slows its wearer more than the plain one. Tick this to swap them back: Articulated Metal Shin Armor 0.90, Metal Shin Armor 0.85. Nothing else about either item changes. Only newly made armor is affected; pieces that already exist may keep the value they were made with.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_NoFastMoveFallDa: [BETA] No Fall Damage With Fast Move

Fast Move can carry a player over stairs faster than the game puts them on the steps, leaving them in the air until they drop, often to their death. Tick this so a player with Fast Move on glides down to the floor instead and takes no damage, without needing God Mode, which would also heal every wound and clear every moodle. Normal falls are not affected.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_DeleteNegativeWe: Items with a negative weight reduce a player's encumbrance and let them carry far more than they should. Tick this to delete any such item. Player inventories are checked every few seconds, and the floor, containers, corpses and vehicles around a player are checked as they come within reach. Each deletion is written to the server log.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_SyncBrokenClothi: When worn clothing is torn down to zero condition, the game drops it only on that player's screen, and the server keeps the undamaged item, which comes back on relog. Tick this to drop the broken item for real, so everyone sees it and it stays broken.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_RescueHutchAnima: Rescue Animals Lost In Hutch Nest Boxes

A hen laying an egg gives up her place inside the hutch while she sits in the nest box, so another bird can take it. If every place is taken when she finishes, the game deletes her instead of putting her back, and the player just sees a chicken that vanished. Tick this to catch her and put her back: into her own hutch, or one nearby, or a nest box if the coop really is full. Each rescue is written to the server log.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_HutchDirtSpeed_t: How fast hutches and their nest boxes get dirty, as a share of normal. 1 is vanilla and changes nothing; 0.25 is a quarter of the mess; 0 means they never get dirty. Nest boxes are the reason this exists: vanilla rolls for nest box dirt once per laying hen every frame, about eighty times as fast as the hutch floor beside it, so a busy coop goes from clean to filthy in a couple of minutes. Cleaning by hand is untouched, and time spent away from the coop is not affected.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_NoStairAutoVault: No Auto Vault Over Stair Railings

Running into a low fence vaults it automatically, and the game never checks what is on the other side, so a jogging player who brushes the railing of a staircase, or the railing round a stairwell, goes over it and falls. Tick this to stop the automatic vault for railings on or beside stairs. Ordinary fences on flat ground still auto vault, and a stair railing can still be climbed on purpose by stopping and using the interact key.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_MultiplayerFastF: Puts the single player speed buttons and keys back on screen in multiplayer. Choosing a speed is a vote: the game only speeds up once every living player has chosen fast forward, and then at the slowest speed anyone chose. Timed actions such as reading or crafting speed up with it, including one already under way, and so do actions that work step by step (milking, shearing, reading, exercising, drinking, filling or emptying water and fuel), moving items between containers, cooking, and food heating up or cooling down, which on a server otherwise go at normal speed whatever the game speed. A player going back to normal speed takes back only their own vote: the game drops to normal speed, but everyone else's votes stay, so it speeds up again as soon as that player votes again. Finishing an action, or moving or driving, takes back that player's vote the same way (a player moving at fast forward speed breaks the anti-cheat's speed limit and gets kicked). A zombie close to anyone stops it and clears everyone's vote. Single player is not affected.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AutoFastForwardA: Needs Multiplayer Fast Forward. Lets each player turn on auto fast forward for themselves: right-clicking a fast forward button turns it yellow, and right-clicking it again turns auto off. The choice is kept on the player's computer. While a button is yellow, a player who has been busy with timed actions (reading, crafting, building...) for Auto Fast Forward Delay seconds votes for that speed automatically, and finishing takes the vote back. The game still only speeds up while every player is voting, so it runs fast while everyone is busy with an action (or has voted by hand) and drops to normal while anyone is idle. Walking or driving takes the vote back until the player stands still at the action. Fishing never votes, including picking up the catch. Pressing Normal Speed, or a zombie close to anyone, stops it until that player's next action. Turn this off to hide the choice from everyone.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AutoFastForwardD: Seconds a player must have been busy with timed actions before auto fast forward votes for them, so quick actions (eating a snack, equipping, opening a door) finish at normal speed and only long ones, or a long queue of actions, get sped up. Actions queued back to back count as one; a break of more than a second, or walking to the next action, starts the count again. 0 votes as soon as an action starts.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_GoMTooltipLineLe: Guns of Marz Tooltip Line Length

The game lists every weapon an attachment fits on one tooltip line, and a tooltip is only ever as narrow as its widest line, so once Guns of Marz has added thirty guns a scope or a laser throws a banner across the screen. Set the greatest number of characters a line may have and the list is rebuilt below the heading, wrapped, never splitting a name. Around 40 reads well; 0 leaves the tooltips as they are. The game writes its own heading before the wrapped list and it is left with nothing after it, because a tooltip can only be added to, never edited. Does nothing unless Guns of Marz is loaded.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_NISFShiftRange: Nick's Inventory Selection Fix Shift Range
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_NISFShiftRange_t: Once Nick's Inventory Selection Fix stops selections from deselecting themselves, shift-clicking in an inventory or loot window can act like ctrl-clicking, adding one item at a time instead of selecting everything between. Tick this to make shift-click always select the whole range, including after a drag-box selection. Nick's mod ships its own attempt at this, which does not work, so this one runs ahead of it. Does nothing unless Nick's Inventory Selection Fix is loaded.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_TurboGameMultipl: Turbo Game's handheld console only half works on a server. Putting in a cartridge, taking it out and putting in a battery happen on the player's screen and not on the server, a console spawned from the item list can never take a cartridge, and the battery charge, the best scores and the boredom, unhappiness and stress a game changes all reset on relog. Tick this to have the server do all of it, so it sticks for everyone. A cartridge can then also go into an empty Turbo console, and the battery charge stays with the device it was in. Best scores and an unfinished Sudoku stay with the console they were played on too, so each console has its own, also in single player. The character also stays put while a game window is open, instead of walking around when the game's keys are pressed. Escape closes a game window. A game also cannot be played, and closes if it is open, when a zombie is near or it is too dark to read. Also works in single player. Does nothing unless Turbo Game is loaded.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminSpawnProtec: An admin brought back to a character that died, by reviving it on the server, loads in with the same fatal injuries and dies again straight away. Set a number of seconds and every admin who joins is fully restored the moment they arrive: every wound healed, infection cured, hunger, thirst, tiredness and the rest reset. They are then in god mode for that many seconds, after which it switches off again, unless they already had it on. 0 turns this off. Only admins, meaning roles that can turn on their own god mode, are affected, so relogging is never a free heal for players. Multiplayer only. Each restore is written to the server log.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_BodyStatsEditor_: The debug menu's Body panel only opens with the -debug launch option, only edits the admin's own character, and in multiplayer most of what it changes is undone by the server within a second. Tick this to give admins and moderators a Body button in the Player Stats window, an Edit your Body Stats button in the admin panel and a Body Stats entry in the scoreboard's right-click menu. It changes any online player's hunger, thirst, mood, health, infection, nutrition, weight, fitness and the other body stats on the server, so the changes stick and the player sees them. Needs the Can Modify Body Stats capability, never works on a player whose role ranks higher, and every change is written to the admin log.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_ChopperControls_: Adds Send Chopper and Stop Chopper to the right-click Debug menu, and makes the debug menu's Add Chopper and Remove Chopper buttons do the same on a server. With vanilla's stop, the chopper event sends the chopper straight back within a minute or two for as long as the event lasts, and a late network packet can turn the chopper back on for some players. They then hear it hovering until they relog, and stopping it again does nothing, and the same can happen when the chopper event ends by itself. Stop Chopper ends today's chopper event if it is on, tells every player the chopper is gone, even when it already is, and repeats it over the next few seconds, so it also silences a chopper someone still hears after it left. With the Helicopter sandbox option on Sometimes or Often, the next chopper day is still planned as usual. The chopper still goes to a random online player, as in vanilla, and takes about a minute to fly in. Only for roles that may use the /chopper command, which are admins and moderators by default. Multiplayer only. Each use is written to the admin log.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_AdminHotbar_tool: Adds an Admin Hotbar button to the left sidebar, under the Admin button, for admins and moderators, and in single player when the game runs with the -debug launch option, where vanilla offers its own admin tools. It shows a floating bar of shortcuts to every admin tool: the Admin Powers, the admin panel windows, the right-click Tools and Debug menus (teleport, spawn vehicle, horde manager, make noise, thunder, fire), meta events, weather and climate, stories, animals, server messages and options, and player actions such as god mode, teleport, bring, add XP, kick and ban. A shortcut can carry settings (a target player, a location, an item, a vehicle, a saved climate or body preset) and then runs in one click; one without settings opens the vanilla window for it. Toggles such as god mode, rain or a climate preset turn green while on, amber while the server has not confirmed them yet. Every Item List, Spawn Vehicle, Horde Manager, Climate Control, Server Options, Teleport and Body window gets an Add to Hotbar button. Icons can be any image the game already has. Each admin keeps their own bar per server, and can bind a key to show it and a key to each of the first ten slots under Options, Key Bindings (Shift, Ctrl and Alt work). Every shortcut uses the game's own commands and needs the same role permissions as the vanilla tool it stands in for.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_NoWalkOnSquarePi: No Walking When Picking A Square

The debug Horde Manager's Pick New Square button and the Tile Picker use the same cursor as building, so clicking a square makes the character walk over to it first, sometimes a long way, unless the build cheat is on. Tick this so picking a square only selects it and the character stays where they are. Nothing is built or changed either way; only the walk is skipped.
Sandbox_ZomboidFixesB42_BooksStayRead_to: A skill book counts as read (the tick in the inventory, the Literature window) only when every page is recorded on the character, and in multiplayer the server's record is the one kept. The server never records the last pages when a book is finished: read with the instant timed actions cheat, the book is not recorded at all, and read normally it is often left a page short. It looks read until the next login and then shows as unread again. Tick this so a finished book is recorded as fully read on the server.
